questions.subject: Nigerian History
questions.subtopic: Locating Nok on a coordinate map
questions.learningObjective: Locate Nok using a latitude and longitude description.
questions.prompt: Nok is at about 9.50° N and 8.02° E. Which point marks Nok? Explain how the north and east values together rule out point C.
questions.answer: Point D. It is at about 9.50° N and 8.02° E. Point C is farther south, near 6.02° N, and farther west, near 7.02° E.
questions.explanation: A map location needs both coordinates. A higher north value is farther north, and a higher east value is farther east on this grid.

markingGuide.description: Uses latitude to distinguish Nok from C.
Uses longitude to distinguish Nok from C.

stimulus.title: Four historical locations in present-day Nigeria
stimulus.textAlternative: North is up and east is right. Lettered locations on a latitude–longitude grid: A = 7.48° N, 4.56° E; B = 6.32° N, 5.68° E; C = 6.02° N, 7.02° E; D = 9.50° N, 8.02° E. Each mark is a present-day reference point. No boundaries are shown.

questions.subject: Nigerian History
questions.learningObjective: Locate Ile-Ife on a map by comparing its position with the other sites.
questions.prompt: Ile-Ife is the westernmost of the four sites marked. Find its letter, then describe its position relative to Benin City at B using a two-part compass direction.
questions.answer: A is Ile-Ife. It is north-west of Benin City, since A is higher and farther left than B.
questions.explanation: A has the lowest longitude. It also has a higher latitude than B.

markingGuide.description: Describes A as north-west of B or explains both component directions.

questions.subject: Nigerian History
questions.learningObjective: Locate the present-day reference point for Benin City and distinguish it from an area on a historical map.
questions.prompt: The marker for Benin City, Edo State, belongs just south and east of Ile-Ife at A and west of Igbo-Ukwu at C. Choose its letter and explain why this marker cannot show the full extent of the historical Kingdom of Benin.
questions.answer: B marks Benin City. The marker locates one city. It does not show the area governed by the kingdom or how its extent changed.
questions.explanation: Point B fits both relative position clues. A city location and a kingdom’s territorial extent are different information.

markingGuide.description: Explains that a city marker does not show the kingdom’s territorial extent.

questions.subject: Nigerian History
questions.subtopic: Adding Igbo-Ukwu to a locator key
questions.learningObjective: Locate Igbo-Ukwu using a map and write an accurate locator key entry.
questions.prompt: A museum caption places Igbo-Ukwu in Anambra State at approximately 6.02° N and 7.02° E. Write the missing map-key entry with its letter, site and present-day state. Identify the grid intersection nearest to the marker.
questions.answer: C — Igbo-Ukwu, Anambra State. The nearest grid intersection is 6° N, 7° E.
questions.explanation: The rounded coordinates place C near the intersection of those grid lines. The modern state name is useful for orientation.

markingGuide.description: Gives the correct letter and site name.
Includes Anambra as the present-day state.
Gives the nearest grid intersection as 6° N, 7° E.
